ios.desc:
Achiva: Record wins, find challenges
Achiva helps you log your past accomplishments and, whenever you’re craving a fun new challenge, offers you fresh inspiration.

“Solo Travel,” “Watching Fireflies,” “Becoming a Parent for the First Time,” “Summiting Everest” — big or small, these moments are worth recording.
With that in mind, I created this personal achievement collector app. It’s both a way to cheer yourself on and to light up your ordinary days with new possibilities.
If life feels dull and you don’t know what to do this weekend, browse Achiva for fun achievements to tackle!

For example
- “Take a photo with an interesting road sign”
- “Mix your own cocktail”
- “Sleep for 12 hours straight”
- “Go stream trekking”
- …and many more achievements are added all the time!

Main Features
-Completed / Wish-to-Complete Lists: Review your achievements, view posters, captions, and notes. Savour that sense of accomplishment.  
-Achievement Library: Browse every achievement — both done and undone. From serious to playful, sortable by category and rarity.  
-Customized Achievements: Record your own personal achievements!
-Notes: Jot down how you felt when you completed each achievement. Those words will move you when you read them later.    
-Discovery: Too many achievements to scroll through? In “Discovery,” you’ll see 21 new achievements each day — some hidden achievements only appear here. Swipe right on the ones you want to try!  
-Dashboard: How many achievements have you completed? How many are on your wish list? What are their rarity and category distributions? How many words in your comments? See it all at a glance.  
-Personalization: Blur effects, text animations, “breathing” vibrations, and more — customize to your heart’s content.
    
We need rituals to mark the before and after. Often there are no flowers or applause, and no one’s watching. Some achievements are tiny — buying a single flower; some are huge — exploring sky and sea; some are solemn — a wedding ceremony; some are silly — pulling a funny face in a selfie; some are easy for one person but hard for another.
No matter what, record it. Achiva gives you a “ritual of recognition” — proof that you really changed from before to after.
In the end, you’ll discover you’ve accomplished so much without even noticing.

You’re also welcome to submit your own achievements. I’ll regularly curate and update them.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made a gamified card collector to celebrate personal achievement(App)

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

Last month me and my friend tried Geocaching, an outdoor activity for your to find treasure boxes. Even though we didn't find the treasure, we both think this is worth celebrating.

As a game designer and card game lover, I hoped it would be so cool if I can have achievements recorded as cards, and review them as my collections.

So I made an App called Achiva, and now it's available on App Store.

There are achievements like:
- Sleep for 12 hours
- Geocaching (of course)
- Build Lego
but also serious achievements like:
- Becoming a parent
- Buying a car
- First Job

I hope you will like it!

Astrojan (Haoan)
